steps.name: public-content-approval-and-privacy-audit
steps.summary: 2026-07-27 public defaults were approved: unapproved organization names and internal workflows will be generalized, detailed metrics require evidence, the profile photo and GitHub are public, email/contact form and light theme are excluded, and /portfolio is canonical. All 2 PDF pages and the public UI data were audited; the PDF download was deferred to Step 5 for organization-identifier and filename alignment.

steps.name: shared-shell-accessibility-baseline
steps.summary: Added a keyboard-visible skip link and focusable main target, made Escape close mobile navigation and restore focus, simplified shared responsive widths, and removed the unapproved ThemeToggle and light-theme overrides. Focused RED/GREEN tests, the full test/lint/typecheck/build gates, and Chrome checks at 320/390/768/1440 px passed without horizontal overflow.

steps.name: home-evidence-first-simplification
steps.summary: Replaced the hard-coded project count, skill radar, rotating roles, and decorative status dashboard with projects.length, one representative project from the public collection, and a concise current focus. Home remains a Server Component, links to Portfolio, Resume, the approved public GitHub, and Blog without querying the Blog database, and exposes no email. The representative-project link now includes its project context for descriptive navigation. Focused RED/GREEN, full test/lint/typecheck/build gates, and Chrome checks at 320/390/768/1440 px passed without horizontal overflow.

steps.name: portfolio-list-scanability
steps.summary: Replaced the alternating central timeline with two Featured projects and a four-project career grid backed by the existing approved project collection. Every card now presents period, role, core decision, and verified result in one order without organization names or unsupported metrics; the unused ScrollRevealItem and portfolio reveal CSS were removed. Focused RED/GREEN, full test/lint/typecheck/build gates, six detail-route HTTP checks, and Chrome checks at 320/390/768/1440 px passed without horizontal overflow.

steps.name: portfolio-detail-clarity
steps.summary: Generalized organization-identifying titles, company fields, six routes, and internal workflow descriptions; removed unsupported metric fields and index-based approach/result fallback; placed role and qualitative result before architecture; rendered one architecture surface per project; and reduced the workflow diagram to a focusable, contained public-safe flow. Focused RED/GREEN, 175 tests (163 passed and 12 database tests skipped), lint/typecheck/build, six active 200 plus six retired 404 route checks, and Chrome 320/390/768/1440 px checks passed without page overflow.

steps.name: resume-scanability-and-download-contract
steps.summary: Moved Experience directly after a two-paragraph, 70-character-width profile summary and compacted Skills ahead of Education. Generalized organization identifiers and removed unsupported detailed metrics. Because no safe generalized PDF source exists, removed the old public PDF, download CTA/API, client timer/cooldown, and now-unused download helpers. Focused RED/GREEN 3/3, all 171 tests (159 passed, 12 database tests skipped), lint/typecheck/build, and Chrome 320/390 px overflow checks passed.

steps.name: blog-discovery-resilience
steps.summary: Added a visible two-character search requirement and focus-visible input, aria-current selected tag navigation, distinct unfiltered/tag/search empty states, and route loading/error boundaries that never replace database failures with fixtures. Focused RED/GREEN 14/14, all 175 tests (163 passed, 12 database tests skipped), lint/typecheck/build, and actual DATABASE_URL smoke for the 200 Blog list, 200 empty search, 429 rate limit, and isolated database-failure browser boundary passed.

steps.name: seo-and-crawler-foundation
steps.summary: Added request-time root metadataBase, title template, shared OG/Twitter defaults, page-specific metadata and canonical URLs for every public page family, safe React-data Person/WebSite/BlogPosting JSON-LD, a favicon, a generated 1200x630 PNG OG image, robots.txt, and a sitemap that combines static and all Portfolio routes with published Blog entries while feed/llms remain Blog-only. Production origin validation rejects missing, non-HTTPS, localhost, and private hosts; legacy /projects routes now return 308. Focused RED/GREEN 8/8, all 185 tests (173 passed and 12 database tests skipped), lint/typecheck/build, and production-container HTTP checks for canonical, JSON-LD, 11 sitemap entries, crawler boundaries, assets, and redirects passed.

steps.name: public-launch-quality-gate-and-doc-sync
steps.summary: A production-like Compose dry-run verified published Blog HTML/Markdown and crawler outputs while failed/private slugs receive strict HTTP 404 through a small database-backed Proxy boundary. Six public pages passed Chrome checks at 320/390/768/1440 px with no horizontal overflow, first-Tab skip links, and reduced-motion coverage. Lighthouse measured Performance 96, Accessibility 96, Best Practices 100, and SEO 100. The public privacy constraints (no Contact/email, PDF download, or light theme) and canonical DB-backed routes were rechecked; roadmap and planning docs now state the current baseline. Next execution target is auto-publish-ops-hardening Step 4, which remains approval-required until a real HTTPS public origin and privacy organization/private-repository lists are supplied.

steps.name: career-content-evidence-alignment
steps.summary: Aligned Portfolio and Resume with approved career evidence: three current Java/Spring cases are Featured, five prior career projects retain verified metrics, and the Go GitHub/Discord automation is explicitly a side project. Gitea Actions, Jenkins, cache warmup, and professional-versus-personal skill boundaries now match the source while organization identifiers and the source PDF remain private and the Home radar remains unchanged. Focused tests passed 15/15; the full suite passed 181 with 12 database skips, plus lint, typecheck, build, 12 production HTTP route checks, and content smoke.
